LAW AND MOTION 301, DEMURRER TO COMPLAINT -APPEARANCES: RALPH G. LATZA FOR DEFENDANTS YAN KANG ZHANG, YING LAN ZHANG, YAN RONG ZHANG AND MEI TAN LIANG DEMURRING PARTIES. MARILYN KALMAN FOR PLAINTIFF LEONARD C. PARDOE OPPOSING PARTY. THE COURT ADOPTED ITS TENTATIVE RULING -- DEFENDANT YAN KANG ZHANG'S DEMURRER TO COMPLAINT: DEMURRER IS OVERRULED WITH RESPECT TO 1ST & 2ND CAUSES OF ACTION FOR BREACH OF IMPLIED WARRANTY OF HABITABILITY (TORT AND CONTRACT); 3RD & 4TH CAUSES OF ACTION FOR BREACH OF COVENANT OF QUIET ENJOYMENT (CONTRACT & TORT); 5TH CAUSE OF ACTION FOR RETALIATORY EVICTION; 6TH CAUSE OF ACTION FOR NEGLIGENT INFLICTION OF EMOTIONAL DISTRESS; 7TH CAUSE OF ACTION FOR INTENTIONAL INFLICTION OF EMOTIONAL DISTRESS; 8TH CAUSE OF ACTION FOR NEGLIGENCE; 10TH CAUSE OF ACTION FOR VIOLATION OF RENT ORDINANCE; 11TH CAUSE OF ACTION FOR VIOLATION OF CIVIL CODE SECTION 787.2 & 12TH CAUSE OF ACTION FOR SPECIFIC PERFORMANCE. DEMURRER SUSTAINED WITH LEAVE AS TO 9TH CAUSE OF ACTION FOR PARTIAL CONSTRUCTIVE EVICTION. 13TH CAUSE OF ACTION FOR IMPROPER METERING OF UTILITY SERVICES UNDER CIVIL CODE SECTION 1940.9 IS SUSTAINED WITH LEAVE TO AMEND TO ALLEGE THAT DEFENDANTS KNOWINGLY PROVIDED ELECTRIC SERVICE TO OTHERS THROUGH PLAINTIFF'S METER IF PLAINTIFF CAN SO PLEAD IN GOOD FAITH. ORDER SIGNED IN OPEN COURT. (JJM/KH) ERIC L. THRONE, CSR 7855
